description.value:
Cast with 1 action, this power causes ordinary vegetation in a 100-foot radius around a point you choose to grow wild and tangled; crossing the area costs 4 feet of movement for every foot traveled. You may carve out any number of smaller areas within the effect to leave unaffected.

Cast instead over 8 hours, the power causes every plant within a half-mile radius of a chosen point to yield double its normal harvest for the next year.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Light Side Powers, Level 3
